surface.description: Dotted surface name, for example `build.main` or `dialog.add-tool`.

dumpFile.description: Filename of the raw DOM dump inside `coral-schema/surfaces/`.

testIdOnlyNonInteractive.description: Elements carrying a test id that are nonetheless not interactive.

missingLabel.description: Interactive elements with no derivable accessible name.

occludedVisibleNotTopmost.description: Visible in layout but covered by another element at their centre point.

dupTestIdsInSurface.description: Test ids appearing more than once within this one surface.

CoralSurface.description:
One captured surface: a full DOM dump of a page or dialog.

`interactive` and `hasTestId` are tracked independently on purpose. Coral attaches test ids to many non-interactive wrappers, so the presence of a test id is not a signal that an element can be clicked.
